crossRefs.note: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met…
It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my…
but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they…
Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let…
For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for…
Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. “But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.”
seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
